text.38:20: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
text.38:23: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.
text.78:37: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
